emma_cs: FYI customer reported truncated SSE stream after a reconnect. They get a partial completion then a reconnect resumes with the rest, but sometimes we see duplicate tokens and double billing. Repro steps attached.
carlos_sre: ugh. do we have request ids or session tokens from the customer? that helps match duplicates.
dev-bot: [ingest] connection 92ab3: sse_disconnect reason=network_error; session_id=svc-772; resume_token=rt-9f2a; last_emit_seq=124
ashley_support: repro from customer (cleaned):
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams?model=gpt-jumbo &
# wait ~5s, kill client (SIGINT), reconnect immediately with same resume token
```
Observed behavior: first connection returns tokens up to "...final sentence part 1" then on reconnect we get "...final sentence part 1" again followed by " part 2". billing shows tokens counted twice for overlapping bytes.
carlos_sre: thanks. sounds like resume semantics not deduping overlap when last_emit_seq wasn't acked. do we have server-side ack window info? @dev-bot any recent changes to resume window logic?
dev-bot: [deploy] patch 2025-11-02T03:12:15Z adjusted resume-window default from 100 -> 50 for streaming runtime v4.7
jordan_prod: that change was to reduce memory but may make clients more likely to replay last few tokens. we should be explicit in client SDKs and docs about last-ack semantics. also add a server-side de-dupe by sequence id if possible.
emma_cs: customer wants engineering guidance now — they said this is happening intermittently and it's causing overcharges for high-volume users.
ashley_support: asked customer for full response headers; they provided:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Type: text/event-stream
X-Redwood-Session: svc-772
X-Resume-Token: rt-9f2a
X-Emit-Seq: 124
```
carlos_sre: X-Emit-Seq is helpful. current behavior: when client reconnects with resume token, server resumes at seq+1 normally. but if last fragment from previous connection wasn't fully acked by client (client terminated before confirming), server can't tell if client consumed last fragment -> we replay. need idempotency marker or a client-supplied last-seen-seq on reconnect.
jordan_prod: proposal:
- require reconnect payload include last_confirmed_seq (client SDKs should set). if missing, treat as possibly unacked and replay last chunk but mark duplicates in telemetry.
- add a short-lived idempotency window on server: if reconnect happens within 3s and emits overlap, suppress billing for overlapped tokens (server-side best-effort) and emit duplicate-warning event to client.
ashley_support: can we do a quick mitigation for impacted customers? maybe a billing credit and a guidance doc for immediate client-side workaround.
emma_cs: customer asked for repro steps we can share. can we give a shim: on client disconnect, wait 200ms-500ms before reconnect and include last_confirmed_seq header? example snippet?
carlos_sre: yes. sample header on reconnect:
```
POST /v1/streams/resume HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "resume_token": "rt-9f2a",
  "last_confirmed_seq": 124
}
```
Server currently accepts resume_token only, but will log last_confirmed_seq if provided.
jordan_prod: follow-ups: eng runtime team will add server-side de-dupe by seq id in the next patch (ETA 48h), plus a telemetry metric for "replay_overlap_tokens". support team should offer temporary billing credit and ask customers to adopt the reconnect header workaround.
ashley_support: I'll draft the response and credit offer. proposed message to customer:
- apology and explanation
- ask them to delay immediate reconnect by ~300ms, or include last_confirmed_seq in reconnect body
- offer a credit for overlapped tokens while we roll out server fix
emma_cs: thanks. can eng spike the de-dupe change and confirm break/fix window? we need exact timeline for the customer.
carlos_sre: I'll open an internal ticket and start the patch. ETA: review today, canary tomorrow, full roll tomorrow evening. will post PR link here.
dev-bot: [ticket] INFR-8742 created by carlos_sre - streaming: resume dedupe by seq id
jordan_prod: I'll coordinate the billing credit process and approve. we should also update public docs for SDKs with last_confirmed_seq guidance.
ashley_support: customer response: "thank you — we'll apply the short delay as a band-aid and await your fix." :relieved:
emma_cs: great. action items:
- carlos: PR + canary
- jordan: billing credit + docs update
- ashley/emma: send customer note + ask for headers/logs from any other affected customers
carlos_sre: ack. PR coming in ~3h.
dev-bot: [pr] https://git.redwood/infra/streaming/pulls/458 (wip)
